$comment: The miniphim's days. SUMMON (on): every two minutes the mail worker (mail/src/clock.mjs, summonTick) reads summon.from's public Delvetown posts; one that addresses miniphim (an @mention, or a reply to one of its posts) commits a request built from this file with summon.request on top, which starts whetstone.yml. While they're up they handle every notification and can read, follow, like and post. CLOCK (enabled; off since 2026-10-06 at the person's word): four town days a day, at 01:23, 07:23, 13:23, 19:23 UTC. Turning either on or off is an edit to this file in a commit.
